text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — I'm wrapping up the release notes draft for next week's docs deploy. Need eyes on SDK snippets + migration checklist. PR #4521 has the draft. Can someone take snippet QA and link sweep? Thx

Kevin Patel: On it. I'll check Python + Ruby SDK examples for the param renames and any API surface changes.

Anika Rao: I can handle the migration guide cross-references and deprecation notes. Any specific known issues we should call out?

Maria Chen: Yes — please add this known issue: intermittent 503s from embeddings endpoint for large batches on Dedicated v1 pools. Workaround: reduce `batch_size` or pin to v2 pools. Ticket INC-728.

Jules: Also note the streaming behavior change: function-calling now emits partial JSON chunks. We should add a small parsing example and a 'behavior change' bullet.

Samir Khan: Where's the new streaming example located? I can validate the parsing snippet.

Maria Chen: PR #4530 contains the streaming example. Snippet path is `docs/examples/streaming/function_calling.py`. Please run it locally against the latest SDK before we merge.

Kevin Patel: Heads-up: the Python snippet uses `client.generate(..., top_k=50)` but the SDK renamed that param to `candidate_k`. I'll push a tiny fix to the snippet.

Anika Rao: I'll add a migration mapping table (old -> new param names) and a short note about tokenization differences when migrating from 0.9 -> 1.0.

DocsBot: deploy-bot: Staging site scheduled deploy at 2025-03-12T02:00Z — release notes must be merged before 2025-03-11T23:00Z.

Maria Chen: OK timeline noted. Can we get a final pass by EOD today? @Kevin Patel @Anika Rao @Jules @Samir Khan

Jules: :thumbsup: I'll do the streaming parsing example and check the JS snippet as well.

Samir Khan: I ran the python streaming snippet locally — small failing test: `client.create_chat` now returns a tuple. Pushing a quick fix to PR #4530.

Kevin Patel: Fixed the param rename in #4521-pt1 and updated the inline code sample.

Maria Chen: Thanks. One last ask — can someone run the link-checker script? We had a few 404s in the migration guide last time.

Anika Rao: Running link-checker now: `./scripts/linkcheck.sh docs/migration`

Anika Rao: Link check done — two redirects to update (old blog links). I'll replace them with the canonical urls.

Maria Chen: Perfect. I'll merge the release notes after these fixes and ping the release manager. If anything else pops up drop a note here.

Kevin Patel: Quick diff reminder for snippets: prefer `client.chat.create(...)` over raw HTTP examples to match SDK idioms.

Jules: Noted. Also adding a tiny parse guard in the JS streaming example to handle partial JSON frames.

Samir Khan: All PRs updated, leaving final reviews now.

Maria Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone, will merge after green CI and link fix.
